pattern_explanation: The Turkish words look like English words that Turkish speakers may already know, but their meanings have drifted apart. Learners often assume the English word has the same meaning as its Turkish look-alike and choose the wrong English word.
false_friend_warning: Learners should not trust the spelling of the Turkish word: the English word that looks similar (sympathetic, eventual, actual, college) has a different meaning, so the Turkish-based guess leads to a wrong answer.
